title: Introducing: Sales Order Agent (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Accessing and Activating the Sales Order Agent
Agent Interface and Task Pane Navigation
Item Availability Page and Response Generation
Sales Quote Creation and Processing Multiple Requests

features.name: Sales Order Agent
features.description: An AI agent that automates the process of managing sales team operations by capturing quotes and converting them into sales orders directly from customer emails without manual intervention.
caveats: Only works with registered contacts and customers in Business Central
Requires Microsoft 365 shared mailbox account for monitoring incoming emails
Requires users to be added to the agent to interact with it

features.name: Sales Order Agent Configuration
features.description: An activation dialog that allows administrators to configure the sales order agent with minimal setup, including defining a mailbox account to monitor for incoming customer requests.
caveats: Mailbox must be a Microsoft 365 shared mailbox

features.name: Agent Task Pane
features.description: A view accessible from the Copilot pane where users can see tasks coming in from the monitored mailbox and the agent can start processing incoming customer quote requests.
caveats: Users do not need to keep the task pane open as the agent will notify when attention is required

features.name: Item Availability Page
features.description: A page used by the sales order agent to check inventory availability by applying filters for item, date, customer, location and quantity to determine if requested items are in stock.
caveats: Page includes unit price, discount and other parameters to calculate availability
Requires specific filters for accurate availability checking

features.name: Item Search Across Multiple Tables
features.description: The agent searches inventory across multiple data sources including the item table, extended texts, translations, item attributes, and item categories to find the correct items matching customer requests.
caveats: Limited to items and attributes already configured in the system

features.name: Automatic Sales Quote Creation
features.description: The agent automatically creates sales quotes based on customer email requests, populating quote details including items, quantities, delivery dates, and customer purchase document numbers.
caveats: Requires human review and confirmation before sending quote to customer
Agent can iterate on quotes if customer requests changes

features.name: Agent KPIs Dashboard
features.description: A dashboard showing key performance indicators for the sales order agent including tasks processed, email volume, time savings, and conversion rates.
caveats: KPIs show zero values until agent begins processing tasks

features.name: Contact Registration During Processing
features.description: The agent can notify users when an incoming email is from an unknown contact and provides a convenient just-in-time experience to create and register that contact in Business Central before proceeding with the quote request.
caveats: Only works with registered contacts and customers currently
Requires manual contact creation for unknown senders

features.name: Sales Order Agent Email Processing
features.description: The agent automatically reads inbound emails, scans for items, checks availability, and pre-creates sales quotes with quantities and details requested by customers without manual data entry.

features.name: Sales Order Agent Natural Language Conversation
features.description: The agent converses with customers in natural language through email, responding to inventory questions, preparing sales quotes based on customer requests, and converting quotes to orders.

features.name: Agent Email Safety and Relevance Filtering
features.description: The agent filters inbound emails and tags those that are not relevant to sales (promotional ads) with warnings, and blocks harmful content messages from processing.
caveats: User can override non-relevant email filtering if desired
Harmful messages are blocked and not made visible to process

features.name: Agent Permission Sets
features.description: Administrators control agent authorization scope through permission sets that outline the exact permissions needed for the agent to fulfill its task, with ability to modify, make stricter, or more flexible.
caveats: Permission sets come pre-built by Microsoft but can be tuned by administrators
Agent must be disabled to modify permissions

features.name: Agent Profile Configuration
features.description: Administrators can assign profiles to agents to control their interaction surface, exposing or hiding controls, fields, and actions. Custom fields and actions can be added to the agent profile to make them discoverable and usable by the agent.
caveats: Customizations must be added to the agent profile to be available to the agent

features.name: Agent UI Access Model
features.description: The agent accesses Business Central through the user interface, connecting to actions, controls, and data displayed on the UI using metadata about action names and captions to reason about task completion.
